text:
leo: Alert from scheduled scan: partner archival bucket contains full webhook headers incl. `Authorization: Bearer svc_tok_XXXX` for tenants tenant-11, tenant-77, tenant-314. Likely long-lived tokens. No obvious user PII but exposure surface is serious.

anya: timeline? when were these issued?

leo: tokens issued ~2026-03-02 per Vault metadata. I sampled objects: s3://partner-archive/2026/03/02/.. showing headers in plaintext.

devon: immediate mitigation: (1) disable partner token issuance roles in Vault; (2) revoke existing tokens for affected tenants; (3) generate short-lived replacements (TTL 10m) for canary; (4) rotate AWS KMS alias used to wrap partner envelope keys; (5) request deletion of archived objects on partner side.

anya: I'll run CloudTrail + Athena searches for use of those tokens and produce a CSV of principals + IPs. Query will look like: `SELECT userIdentity.arn, eventTime FROM $CT WHERE requestParameters.headers LIKE '%svc_tok_%'`

leo: canary: start with tenant-314 (lowest traffic). devon do you want to handle revoke and partner notification?

devon: yes. Commands: `vault write auth/token/revoke <id>` and `aws kms create-alias --alias-name alias/partner-wrap-2026-03 --target-key-id <new>` then rewrap via small job. I'll coordinate with partner for alias switch.

audit-bot: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/thirdparty-token-exposure | Incident created SEC-2026-910 (P2)

anya: uploaded initial CSV to secure drive, found 8 principals and 2 suspicious IPs.

devon: tenant-314 canary rotated and partner validated health endpoint. Starting tenant-11 and tenant-77 rotation now.

leo: after rotation enforce Vault policy TTL cap for partner roles and add CI lint to disallow printing Authorization headers in onboarding scripts. Filing follow-up JIRA.

anya: closing note: ops run a sweep for any other buckets with `Authorization:` patterns older than 180 days and flag for deletion. Thanks team. :lock:
